about.sobreStructonixText: Structonix Sistem Global SL is a modern full-service construction and engineering company that delivers projects of any complexity across Spain. We support the client at every stage: from land selection and acquisition to commissioning the building. This approach allows us to fully control the process and guarantee a predictable outcome.
about.equipoStructonixText: Our team consists of more than 40 highly qualified specialists integrated into a single system: architects, engineers, builders, designers and project managers. But the company's key advantage is the extensive technical experience within the team.
about.gestionAdministrativaText:
In every project, thanks to our Administrative Management system, we coordinate the interaction of all specialists, including professional surveyors and geodesists, who ensure the accuracy of initial data and the correct positioning of the project on site.

Engineering solutions are developed taking into account all technical nuances, and each stage of construction is accompanied by strict technical supervision.
about.controlDeCalidadText:

Internal technical control processes allow us to minimise risks, eliminate errors and guarantee a high level of reliability and durability of the installations.
about.arquitecturaEInnovacionText:
We create modern villas and residential properties, combining architectural aesthetics, innovative technologies and energy-efficient solutions.

Each project is a unique concept, thought through down to the smallest detail.
about.structonixSistemGlobalText: Structonix Sistem Global SL is a team that assumes full responsibility for the result, guaranteeing a turnkey construction from idea to perfect completion.

heroDescription.estructura:
The structure is the technical foundation of every home, villa and residential project. At Structonix Sistem, we build strong, precise and long-lasting structures, paying close attention to every load-bearing element: foundations, columns, walls, slabs and floor systems.

This stage determines not only the safety and stability of the building, but also the architectural freedom of the project. A well-designed and accurately executed structure makes it possible to create open spaces, clean lines and complex construction solutions without compromising strength or quality.

We combine technical expertise, precise execution and strict quality control to deliver reliable structures built for the future. From the foundations to the final slab, every detail is developed to ensure durability, safety and long-term value for the property.
heroDescription.ingenieria:
Engineering integrates all home systems into a unique, well-designed environment that works flawlessly.

Structural, electrical, mechanical and hydraulic solutions are designed as a whole, ensuring comfort and efficiency.
heroDescription.arquitectura:
Architecture is an expression of lifestyle.

It defines the unique character of the villa, combining aesthetics, space and functionality into a harmonious whole.
heroDescription.acabados:
Finishes are the final touch that defines the level of a home.

Attention to detail, quality of materials and precision in execution create a coherent and comfortable environment.
heroDescription.carpinteria:
VentanaPro is a company specialising in high-end aluminium windows and modern glazing systems, offering solutions for comfortable and energy-efficient homes.

The company specialises in panoramic windows with minimalist profiles that provide maximum natural light, excellent thermal and acoustic insulation, and reduced heating and air conditioning costs.

The range includes functional roller shutter systems with solar protection and privacy screening, as well as elegant glazed enclosures for terraces, balconies and staircases.

VentanaPro offers a complete cycle of services, from professional advice and solution selection to quality installation with warranty, ensuring a high level of execution and durability in every detail.
heroDescription.gestion-administrativa:
Administrative management ensures comprehensive project support at all stages of execution.

From obtaining permits to coordinating process participants, every step is supervised and structured.

dataCollected.title: 2. Personal data we process
dataCollected.content:
Through this website we may process the following categories of personal data:

• Identification data: first and last name.
• Contact data: email address and phone number.
• Communication data: content of messages sent via the contact form.
• Technical data: IP address, browsing data and cookies when necessary for security or site operation.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes of processing
purposes.content:
We process your personal data for the following purposes:

• To manage and respond to requests received through the contact form.
• To maintain commercial or informational communications related to our construction, engineering, architecture and investment services.
• To ensure website security and prevent fraudulent or abusive use.
• To comply with applicable legal obligations.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
legalBasis.content:
Processing of your data is based on:

• Your consent when submitting the contact form.
• Pre-contractual measures or management of commercial enquiries.
• Legitimate interest in maintaining website security and preventing spam or fraud.
• Compliance with legal obligations, where applicable.

contactForm.title: 5. Contact form
contactForm.content:
When you use the contact form, we collect the data you voluntarily provide (name, email, phone and message) to handle your enquiry.

Data is securely sent to info@structonixsistem.com via a professional email delivery service. Please do not submit specially protected or confidential information that is not necessary for your request.

The site may use Google reCAPTCHA v3 to protect the form against automated submissions. Use of reCAPTCHA is subject to Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

retention.title: 6. Data retention period
retention.content:
We will retain your personal data for as long as necessary to handle your request and, subsequently, for the periods required by applicable law or until you request deletion, where appropriate.

Communications arising from the contact form will be retained while we maintain a commercial relationship or for a reasonable period to respond to related future enquiries.

recipients.title: 7. Recipients and processors
recipients.content:
Your data may be shared with providers that deliver services necessary for website operation, such as hosting, transactional email (Resend) and security tools (Google reCAPTCHA), always under agreements that ensure confidentiality and compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).

We do not sell or transfer your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes.

rights.title: 8. Your rights
rights.content:
Under the GDPR, you may exercise the following rights:

• Access: know what data we process about you.
• Rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
• Erasure: request deletion of your data where applicable.
• Objection and restriction: object to or restrict certain processing.
• Portability: receive your data in a structured format, where applicable.
• Withdraw consent: at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.

To exercise your rights, email info@structonixsistem.com stating your request and verifying your identity. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es) if you believe processing does not comply with the law.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.content:
This website may use technical cookies necessary for operation and third-party cookies related to security services (reCAPTCHA) or analytics, if implemented in the future.

You can configure your browser to block or delete cookies. Note that some site features may become unavailable if you disable essential cookies.

security.title: 10. Security measures
security.content:
Structonix Sistem Global S.L. applies appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, loss, destruction or alteration.

Among other measures, we use secure connections (HTTPS), form validation, submission rate limiting and antispam verification on the contact form.

changes.title: 11. Changes to this policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect legal changes or improvements to our services. The current version will always be available on this page with the last updated date.

marbella.name: Marbella
marbella.heroTagline: Turnkey luxury villa construction, architecture, engineering and project management for international clients across Marbella, the Golden Mile and Nueva Andalucía.
marbella.overview:
Marbella is the centre of luxury residential construction on the Costa del Sol, attracting buyers and developers from across Europe, the Middle East and the CIS. Structonix delivers contemporary villas, full renovations and ground-up developments here, managing every stage from land due diligence and licensing to handover.

Our team of more than 40 architects, engineers and project managers works as a single integrated unit, which is exactly what international owners need when building remotely. We coordinate municipal permits, technical design and on-site execution so clients keep full visibility without having to live in Spain during the build.
marbella.market: Demand in Marbella is concentrated in the Golden Mile, Nueva Andalucía's Golf Valley, Sierra Blanca and the eastern beachside corridor. Plots are scarce and expensive, so most projects are either premium new builds on the few remaining parcels or complete demolition-and-rebuild schemes. Build quality, energy efficiency and design distinction are the main differentiators in this market, and the LPO (first occupation licence) timeline is a critical factor in any realistic project plan.
marbella.architecture: We design modern Mediterranean and contemporary villas tailored to Marbella's PGOU planning rules, plot orientation and sea views. Our architecture service covers concept design, planning submissions and full technical documentation, always balancing design ambition with what the Marbella town hall will actually approve.
marbella.engineering: Marbella's hillside plots and coastal conditions demand serious structural and MEP engineering. We handle foundations for steep terrain, retaining structures, pools and basements, plus the climate, water and energy systems that a high-end villa requires under Spanish regulations.
marbella.projectManagement: For owners building from abroad, our project management is the core of the service. We act as your single point of contact, controlling budget, schedule, contractors and quality, with structured reporting so you always know the real status of your villa without being on site.
marbella.investment: Marbella combines strong capital appreciation with year-round rental demand at the luxury end. We support investors with build-to-sell and build-to-rent strategies, feasibility studies, and Golden Visa-eligible construction projects, working alongside our For Investors programme to maximise return per square metre.

faq.q: How much does it cost to build a villa in Marbella?
faq.a: Luxury villa construction in Marbella typically ranges from premium to ultra-premium per square metre depending on plot, finishes, pool and basement. We provide a detailed cost breakdown after reviewing your plot and brief.

faq.q: How long does it take to build a villa in Marbella?
faq.a: A turnkey villa usually takes 14–24 months including design and licensing. The building licence (licencia de obra mayor) and first occupation licence (LPO) are the main timeline drivers, and we plan around them from day one.

faq.q: Can foreign owners build in Marbella without living in Spain?
faq.a: Yes. Our project management service is designed for remote owners. We manage permits, contractors and quality control on your behalf and report on progress so you can build from abroad with full confidence.

faq.q: Do you handle building permits and licences in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes. Our administrative management team handles the full licensing process with Marbella town hall, including obra mayor, first occupation licence and energy certification.

faq.q: Which areas of Marbella do you build in?
faq.a: We work across the Golden Mile, Nueva Andalucía, Sierra Blanca, Marbella East and surrounding zones, as well as neighbouring Benahavís and Estepona.

benahavis.name: Benahavís
benahavis.heroTagline: Architecture, engineering and turnkey construction of exclusive villas in Benahavís, La Zagaleta and the hills above Marbella.
benahavis.overview:
Benahavís is the most active luxury new-build market on the Costa del Sol, home to La Zagaleta and some of the most exclusive gated communities in Europe. Its elevated plots offer privacy and panoramic sea views, but they also require advanced engineering and careful planning approval.

Structonix specialises in ground-up villa construction on these demanding hillside sites, combining architectural design with the structural expertise needed to build safely and beautifully on steep terrain.
benahavis.market: The Benahavís market is defined by large private plots, gated estates and ultra-high-net-worth buyers, particularly from the CIS, Northern Europe and the Middle East. Projects here are almost always bespoke new builds rather than renovations, with long-term value driven by exclusivity, privacy and build quality. Planning is managed through the Benahavís municipality, with strict requirements inside communities such as La Zagaleta.
benahavis.architecture: We design statement contemporary villas that respond to Benahavís's dramatic topography, maximising views while respecting estate design codes. Our architects work within the specific rules of gated communities and the local PGOU to secure approval without compromising the design.
benahavis.engineering: Steep hillside plots are the defining engineering challenge in Benahavís. We design deep foundations, retaining walls, terracing, infinity pools and multi-level basements engineered for the terrain, drainage and seismic considerations of the area.
benahavis.projectManagement: Building in a remote hillside estate requires tight logistics and coordination. We manage access, contractors, deliveries and quality control on complex sites, giving overseas owners a single point of accountability from groundwork to handover.
benahavis.investment: Benahavís delivers some of the strongest luxury appreciation on the Costa del Sol, with La Zagaleta among the most prestigious addresses in Spain. We help investors identify viable plots, run build feasibility and deliver villas positioned for premium resale or long-let luxury rental.

faq.q: Why build in Benahavís instead of Marbella?
faq.a: Benahavís offers larger plots, more privacy and panoramic views at a strong value, with La Zagaleta and other gated estates attracting ultra-high-net-worth buyers. It is ideal for bespoke new-build villas.

faq.q: Can you build in La Zagaleta?
faq.a: Yes. We build within gated estates including La Zagaleta, working to their specific design codes and approval processes while managing the full construction.

faq.q: Are hillside plots in Benahavís difficult to build on?
faq.a: They require specialist engineering for foundations, retaining and drainage, which is a core strength of our team. With the right structural design, hillside plots produce exceptional villas with unmatched views.

faq.q: How long does villa construction take in Benahavís?
faq.a: Bespoke hillside villas typically take 16–26 months including design, licensing and groundwork, which is more demanding than flat coastal plots.

faq.q: Do you handle permits in Benahavís?
faq.a: Yes. We manage the full licensing process through the Benahavís municipality and within gated-community requirements.

estepona.name: Estepona
estepona.heroTagline: Turnkey villa construction, architecture and development for the fastest-growing new-build market on the western Costa del Sol.
estepona.overview:
Estepona has become the fastest-growing new-build destination on the Costa del Sol, combining a regenerated old town, an expanding beachfront and strong demand for modern villas at better plot value than central Marbella. It is increasingly attractive to both end-users and developers.

Structonix delivers individual villas and small developments in Estepona, from the New Golden Mile to the hills behind the town, managing design, licensing and construction end to end.
estepona.market: Estepona offers more available land and lower plot prices than Marbella, making it a prime market for both custom villas and developer-led projects. The New Golden Mile corridor is especially active for contemporary villas and boutique developments. Strong infrastructure investment and rising demand make it one of the best risk-adjusted markets on the coast.
estepona.architecture: We design contemporary villas suited to Estepona's beachside and hillside plots, optimising sea views and indoor-outdoor living. Our architecture service covers everything from single villas to multi-unit residential schemes with planning approval through Estepona town hall.
estepona.engineering: From beachfront water-table conditions to elevated inland plots, we engineer foundations, structures, pools and building services appropriate to each site, fully compliant with Spanish and Andalusian regulations.
estepona.projectManagement: Whether a single villa or a small development, our project management keeps budget, programme and quality under control. For developers we provide structured cost and schedule reporting suitable for investors and finance partners.
estepona.investment: Estepona's combination of growth, value and rising demand makes it one of the strongest investment markets on the Costa del Sol. We support build-to-sell developments and build-to-rent villas with feasibility studies and end-to-end delivery designed around return on investment.

faq.q: Is Estepona a good place to build a villa?
faq.a: Yes. Estepona offers more available land and better plot value than Marbella while demand for modern villas keeps rising, especially along the New Golden Mile.

faq.q: How much does it cost to build a villa in Estepona?
faq.a: Construction costs are typically slightly lower than central Marbella due to plot value, though finish level is the main driver. We provide a detailed estimate after reviewing your plot and brief.

faq.q: Do you build developments as well as single villas in Estepona?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver both individual villas and small residential developments, with reporting suitable for developers and investors.

faq.q: Do you manage permits in Estepona?
faq.a: Yes. We handle the full licensing process through Estepona town hall, including building and first occupation licences.

faq.q: Is Estepona good for investment?
faq.a: Estepona offers one of the best risk-adjusted profiles on the coast, with strong growth, infrastructure investment and rising demand supporting both resale and rental returns.

costa-del-sol.name: Costa del Sol
costa-del-sol.h1: Luxury Construction & Development on the Costa del Sol
costa-del-sol.heroTagline: Architecture, engineering, construction and project management for luxury villas and developments across the Costa del Sol.
costa-del-sol.overviewTitle: Building on the Costa del Sol
costa-del-sol.overview:
The Costa del Sol is one of Europe's premier luxury property markets, stretching from Málaga through Marbella, Benahavís and Estepona to Sotogrande. It combines year-round climate, international demand and a mature construction industry serving high-net-worth owners and developers.

Structonix operates across the entire coast, delivering turnkey villas, renovations and developments. Our integrated team manages land, design, licensing and construction so international clients can build with a single trusted partner.
costa-del-sol.market: Across the Costa del Sol, the luxury segment is driven by international buyers seeking new-build quality, energy efficiency and modern design. Each municipality has its own planning rules and licence timelines, which makes local experience essential. From scarce premium plots in Marbella to growth markets in Estepona, we match strategy to each location.
costa-del-sol.architecture: We design contemporary and Mediterranean villas across the coast, tailored to each municipality's planning framework and each plot's orientation and views. Our architecture service runs from concept to fully approved technical documentation.
costa-del-sol.engineering: Coastal conditions, hillside terrain and high-specification villas all demand robust engineering. We deliver structural, MEP and pool engineering compliant with Spanish and Andalusian regulations across every part of the coast.
costa-del-sol.projectManagement: Our project management is built for international owners and developers building from abroad. We control budget, schedule, contractors and quality with transparent reporting, acting as your single point of accountability anywhere on the coast.
costa-del-sol.investment: The Costa del Sol offers durable capital appreciation and strong luxury rental demand. We support investors with feasibility studies, build-to-sell and build-to-rent strategies, and Golden Visa-eligible projects, coordinated through our For Investors programme.

faq.q: Which areas of the Costa del Sol does Structonix build in?
faq.a: We build across the entire coast, with a focus on Marbella, Benahavís, Estepona and the wider Málaga province, including Nueva Andalucía, the Golden Mile and Sotogrande.

faq.q: How much does it cost to build a villa on the Costa del Sol?
faq.a: Costs vary by location, plot and finish level. We provide a detailed, location-specific cost breakdown after reviewing your plot and requirements.

faq.q: Can I build on the Costa del Sol while living abroad?
faq.a: Yes. Our project management service is designed for international owners, managing permits, contractors and quality control on your behalf with regular reporting.

faq.q: Do you handle the full process from land to handover?
faq.a: Yes. We support clients from land due diligence and design through licensing, construction and first occupation, as a single integrated team.

faq.q: Is the Costa del Sol a good construction investment?
faq.a: Yes. The combination of international demand, year-round climate and limited premium supply supports strong appreciation and rental returns, particularly in the luxury segment.

The market is demanding: scarce plots on the Golden Mile and in Nueva Andalucía, strict PGOU planning rules, hillside sites in Sierra Blanca, and discerning international owners who expect both design quality and absolute reliability.

Structonix is an integrated construction company that combines architecture, engineering and project management in a single team of more than 40 specialists. That means one contract, one point of accountability, and one team responsible for your villa from the first sketch to the handover of keys — exactly what owners building from abroad need.

faq.a: A turnkey villa typically takes 14–24 months including design and licensing. We build the licence timeline into the plan from the start to keep the project realistic.

faq.q: Do you handle design as well as construction?
faq.a: Yes. Architecture, engineering and construction are all in-house, so design and build are handled by one team — the core of reliable turnkey villa construction.

constructora-marbella.heroTagline: Structonix is a general contractor in Marbella delivering luxury villas and residences with a single team responsible for design, build and licensing.
constructora-marbella.intro:
A general contractor coordinates every trade, supplier and approval on a building project and carries responsibility for the finished result. In Marbella, where projects span the Golden Mile, Nueva Andalucía and Sierra Blanca, that single line of responsibility is what keeps a luxury build on budget and on schedule.

Structonix acts as your general contractor with architecture, engineering and project management in-house, so the same team that designs your villa also builds it and answers for its quality.

sections.title: What a general contractor delivers
sections.body: We plan the works, contract and supervise every trade, control materials and quality, and manage health and safety on site. You receive one contract, one budget and one accountable partner instead of coordinating separate firms.

sections.title: Single-point responsibility
sections.body: When design, engineering and construction sit with one contractor, there is no gap for problems to fall through. We own the programme end to end, which is decisive for owners building a high-value home from abroad.

sections.title: Built on Marbella experience
sections.body: We know how each town hall and gated community approves and inspects works, and we build to the standards expected in Marbella's premium market — the foundation of a reliable general contractor relationship.

faq.q: What is the difference between a general contractor and a builder?
faq.a: A builder executes construction work, while a general contractor also plans, contracts and supervises all trades and carries overall responsibility for budget, schedule and quality. Structonix provides full general-contractor responsibility.

faq.q: Does the general contractor handle permits in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes. We manage the building licence, first occupation licence and energy certification with Marbella town hall as part of our service.

faq.q: Can you act as general contractor for a villa designed by another architect?
faq.a: Yes. We can build to a third-party design, although most clients prefer our integrated design-and-build model for tighter cost and quality control.

faq.q: How do you control budget as a general contractor?
faq.a: We work from a defined scope and detailed measurements, contract trades competitively and report costs transparently throughout the build.

faq.q: Which areas around Marbella do you cover?
faq.a: The Golden Mile, Nueva Andalucía, Sierra Blanca, Marbella East and neighbouring Benahavís and Estepona on the Costa del Sol.

arquitecto-marbella.heroTagline: Architectural design for luxury villas in Marbella — from concept and planning approval to full technical documentation, by an integrated architecture and engineering team.
arquitecto-marbella.intro:
Great architecture in Marbella balances design ambition with what the local planning framework will actually approve. Plot orientation, sea views, slope and the PGOU rules all shape what can be built on the Golden Mile, in Nueva Andalucía or Sierra Blanca.

Our architects design contemporary and Mediterranean villas tailored to each plot and client, then carry the project through licensing and into construction alongside our engineers.

sections.title: Concept and design
sections.body: We translate your brief, plot and lifestyle into a villa that maximises views, light and indoor-outdoor living, with a clear design language and material palette suited to Marbella.

sections.title: Planning and licensing
sections.body: We prepare and submit the documentation required by Marbella town hall and gated communities, designing within PGOU rules to secure approval without compromising the concept.

sections.title: Design that is built as drawn
sections.body: Because our architects work alongside our engineers and builders, the villa you are shown is the villa you receive — no value-engineering surprises between design and construction.

faq.q: Do I need a local architect to build in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes. A project in Spain must be designed and certified by a qualified architect and submitted to the town hall. Our in-house architects handle this end to end.

faq.q: Can you obtain planning permission in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes. We prepare the technical project and manage the building licence process with Marbella town hall, including communities with their own design codes.

faq.q: Do you only design, or also build?
faq.a: We offer both. Many clients choose our integrated design-and-build service, but we can also deliver architecture and licensing as a standalone service.

faq.q: How long does the design and licensing phase take?
faq.a: Concept to a submitted building licence typically takes several months depending on plot complexity and the community involved; we set a realistic timeline at the start.

faq.q: What architectural styles do you work in?
faq.a: From contemporary minimalist villas to warm modern-Mediterranean designs, always adapted to the plot, views and Marbella's planning context.

villa-construction-marbella.heroTagline: Turnkey luxury villa construction in Marbella — plot, design, licensing, build and handover delivered by one integrated team.
villa-construction-marbella.intro:
Building a villa in Marbella means working with scarce premium plots, demanding hillside engineering and a strict licensing process. Handled well, it is the most rewarding way to own exactly the home you want on the Costa del Sol.

Structonix delivers turnkey villa construction as a single team of architects, engineers and project managers, taking responsibility for the whole build from groundwork to the final snag.

sections.title: From plot to handover
sections.body: We assess your plot, design the villa, engineer the structure and pool, secure licences and build to completion — one partner across the entire journey.

sections.title: Engineering for Marbella plots
sections.body: Sloping plots in Sierra Blanca and view parcels across Marbella demand serious foundations, retaining and drainage. Our engineering unlocks those views safely and durably.

sections.title: Quality you can verify remotely
sections.body: Structured progress reporting and strict quality control let owners follow their villa from abroad with confidence at every stage.

faq.q: What does turnkey villa construction include?
faq.a: Everything from plot assessment, design and engineering to licensing, construction and handover — delivered by one accountable team rather than separate firms.

faq.q: How much does it cost to build a villa in Marbella?
faq.a: It depends on plot, design, finishes, pool and basement. We provide a detailed, transparent cost breakdown after reviewing your plot and brief.

faq.q: How long does it take to build a villa in Marbella?
faq.a: A turnkey villa typically takes 14–24 months including design and licensing, with the building and first occupation licences being the main timeline drivers.

faq.q: Can you build on a steep or sea-view plot?
faq.a: Yes. Hillside and view plots are an engineering strength of ours, from deep foundations to retaining structures and infinity pools.

faq.q: Do you build villas outside Marbella too?
faq.a: Yes, across the Costa del Sol including Benahavís and Estepona — see our Builders Costa del Sol page.

builders-costa-del-sol.h1: Builders on the Costa del Sol
builders-costa-del-sol.heroTagline: Luxury home builders across the Costa del Sol — Marbella, Benahavís, Estepona and beyond — with one integrated team for design, engineering and construction.
builders-costa-del-sol.introTitle: Luxury builders across the Costa del Sol
builders-costa-del-sol.intro:
The Costa del Sol stretches from Málaga through Marbella, Benahavís and Estepona to Sotogrande, and each municipality has its own planning rules and licence timelines. Building well across this coast requires genuine local knowledge in every town.

Structonix builds luxury villas, renovations and developments along the whole coast, bringing the same integrated team and quality standards to every location.

sections.title: Coverage across the coast
sections.body: From the Golden Mile to the New Golden Mile and the hills of Benahavís, we build wherever our clients buy, matching strategy and engineering to each plot and municipality.

sections.title: One team, consistent quality
sections.body: Wherever your plot is, the same architects, engineers and project managers deliver your project to a single high standard, with one point of accountability.

sections.title: Local licensing expertise
sections.body: Each town hall approves works differently. We know the requirements in Marbella, Benahavís, Estepona and the wider province, keeping projects moving.

faq.q: Where on the Costa del Sol do you build?
faq.a: Primarily Marbella, Benahavís and Estepona, and across the wider Málaga province including Nueva Andalucía, the Golden Mile and Sotogrande.

faq.q: Do build costs vary by town on the Costa del Sol?
faq.a: Plot value and access vary more than construction itself; finish level remains the main cost driver. We provide location-specific estimates.

faq.q: Can you manage a build while I live abroad?
faq.a: Yes. Our project management is designed for international owners, with remote reporting and full on-site control.

faq.q: Do you build developments as well as single villas?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver individual villas and small residential developments with reporting suitable for developers and investors.

faq.q: Which town is best to build in?
faq.a: It depends on your goals — Marbella for prestige and rental demand, Benahavís for privacy and views, Estepona for value and growth. We advise per project.

construction-company-marbella.heroTagline: A full-service construction company in Marbella delivering turnkey luxury villas with architecture, engineering and project management under one roof.
construction-company-marbella.introTitle: An integrated construction company in Marbella
construction-company-marbella.intro:
Marbella's luxury market demands a construction company that can manage design, structure and licensing as a single capability, not a chain of subcontractors. International owners expect both design quality and absolute reliability.

Structonix is an integrated construction company of more than 40 specialists, combining architecture, engineering, construction and project management so your villa is delivered by one accountable organisation.

sections.title: Architecture, engineering and construction in one company
sections.body: Keeping all disciplines in-house removes the coordination gaps that derail multi-vendor builds and gives you one organisation responsible for the result.

sections.title: Capacity for complex projects
sections.body: A team of 40+ professionals lets us handle demanding villas and developments while maintaining quality control and structured reporting.

sections.title: Trusted by international clients
sections.body: Multilingual support in English, Russian and Spanish and a remote-owner project model make us a natural partner for buyers across Europe and the CIS.

faq.q: What makes Structonix different from other construction companies in Marbella?
faq.a: We combine architecture, engineering, construction and project management in one in-house team of 40+ specialists, giving you a single point of accountability from design to handover.

faq.q: Do you build across all areas of Marbella?
faq.a: Yes — the Golden Mile, Nueva Andalucía, Sierra Blanca, Marbella East and neighbouring Benahavís and Estepona.

faq.q: Can the construction company manage everything if I live abroad?
faq.a: Yes. We manage permits, contractors and quality control and report on progress so you can build remotely with confidence.

faq.q: Do you handle permits and licences?
faq.a: Yes. Our administrative team manages the full licensing process with Marbella town hall.

faq.q: How much does it cost to build with your company?
faq.a: Costs depend on plot, design and finishes; we provide a detailed, transparent breakdown after reviewing your project.

project-management-marbella.heroTagline: Professional construction project management in Marbella — protecting your budget, schedule and quality as your single point of accountability.
project-management-marbella.intro:
Project management is the discipline that keeps a complex build on budget, on schedule and at the right quality. For owners who do not live in Spain, professional project management is the difference between a smooth build and an expensive one.

Structonix acts as your project manager and owner's representative, controlling cost, programme, contractors and quality from the first decision to the final handover.

sections.title: Cost and schedule control
sections.body: We build a realistic budget and programme, then track them continuously, flagging risks early and keeping decisions and approvals moving.

sections.title: Quality and contractor management
sections.body: We select and supervise trades, enforce specifications and run structured quality checks so the finished villa matches what was promised.

sections.title: Built for remote owners
sections.body: Transparent reporting and a single point of contact let international owners stay fully informed and in control without being on site.

faq.q: What does a construction project manager do?
faq.a: They plan and control budget, schedule, contractors and quality on behalf of the owner, acting as the single accountable point of contact throughout the build.

faq.q: Do I need project management if I already have a builder?
faq.a: Independent project management protects your interests on cost, quality and schedule, which is especially valuable when building from abroad.

faq.q: Can you manage a project another company is building?
faq.a: Yes. We can act as owner's representative overseeing a third-party contractor, or deliver integrated management within our own build.

faq.q: How do you report progress?
faq.a: We provide structured, regular reporting on budget, programme and quality, with photos and clear decisions required from you.

faq.q: Does project management increase the total cost?
faq.a: Good project management typically protects value by avoiding overruns, rework and delays that cost far more than the management fee.

obra-nueva-marbella.heroTagline: New-build villas and homes in Marbella — modern, energy-efficient construction from plot and licensing to handover.
obra-nueva-marbella.intro:
New construction lets you build exactly the home you want, to current standards of energy efficiency, comfort and design, rather than compromising with an existing property. In Marbella, most premium projects are new builds on scarce plots or full rebuilds.

Structonix delivers new-build villas and residences end to end, from plot due diligence and design through the building licence and into construction.

sections.title: The new-build process
sections.body: We confirm what your plot allows under the PGOU, design the home, engineer it and secure the building licence (obra mayor) before construction begins.

sections.title: Modern standards by default
sections.body: New construction lets us deliver high energy efficiency, smart-home readiness and contemporary layouts that older properties rarely match.

sections.title: Licence and certification
sections.body: We manage the building licence, first occupation licence (LPO) and energy certification so your new home is fully legal and ready to register and insure.

faq.q: What is obra nueva (new construction)?
faq.a: It is a ground-up build on a plot, as opposed to renovating an existing property. It requires a building licence (obra mayor) and, on completion, a first occupation licence.

faq.q: What permits does new construction in Marbella need?
faq.a: Principally the obra mayor building licence and the first occupation licence (LPO), plus energy certification. We manage all of them.

faq.q: Is new construction better than renovation?
faq.a: New construction offers modern standards and full customisation; renovation can be better value on the right property. We advise based on your plot and goals.

faq.q: How long does a new-build villa take?
faq.a: Typically 14–24 months including design and licensing, depending on size, plot and complexity.

faq.q: Can I build new on a plot with an old house?
faq.a: Often yes, via demolition and rebuild, subject to PGOU rules. We assess feasibility before you commit.

renovation-marbella.heroTagline: Luxury villa and apartment renovation in Marbella — modernising properties to contemporary standards with full project control.
renovation-marbella.introTitle: Villa and home renovation in Marbella
renovation-marbella.intro:
Renovation transforms an existing Marbella property into a modern home, often unlocking significant value in established areas where new plots are unavailable. Done properly, a renovation rivals new construction in quality and comfort.

Structonix delivers full and partial renovations — from kitchens, bathrooms and interiors to complete structural reforms and extensions — with the same integrated team and control as our new builds.

sections.title: Full and partial renovation
sections.body: Whether modernising interiors or reconfiguring layouts and structure, we plan the works to minimise disruption and protect the parts of the property you want to keep.

sections.title: Permits for renovation works
sections.body: Many reforms require a licence (obra menor or obra mayor depending on scope). We assess the works and manage the right permits with Marbella town hall.

sections.title: Value-driven modernisation
sections.body: Upgrading energy performance, finishes and layout can substantially raise a property's market and rental value — we focus renovation budgets where they return most.

faq.q: Do I need a licence to renovate in Marbella?
faq.a: Cosmetic works may need only a minor works licence (obra menor), while structural changes require a major works licence. We determine and manage the correct permits.

faq.q: Is renovation cheaper than building new?
faq.a: Often, yes — you reuse the existing structure and location. But heavy structural reforms can approach new-build costs; we advise after assessing the property.

faq.q: Can you renovate while keeping part of the house?
faq.a: Yes. We plan partial renovations and phased works to retain elements you value while modernising the rest.

faq.q: How long does a renovation take?
faq.a: From a few months for interiors to a year or more for full structural reforms, depending on scope. We set a clear programme upfront.

faq.q: Do you renovate apartments as well as villas?
faq.a: Yes. We renovate apartments, townhouses and villas across Marbella to a luxury standard.
